item.title: FOX brings in veteran content exec Billy Parks to lead its new creator studio

item.title: Gen Z’s negative feelings about TikTok are starting to affect their usage habits
item.description: Gen Z hasn't yet reached its thirties, but the cohort is already feeling nostalgic for a simpler time. item.title: TikTok’s new music streaming service is literally Apple Music
item.description: TikTok wants to wield its influence within the recording industry, but building a music streaming service is difficult and expensive. item.title: Gotta gift ’em all? Twitch’s experimental feature gives Subscriptions to everyone.
item.description: Twitch viewers can support their favorite streamers by buying Subscriptions for themselves or gifting those units to others. Now, an ongoing experiment is supercharging that revenue stream. The feature is called Gift 'Em All, and as its name implies, it delivers Subscriptions to all of a stream's active viewers at the same time.
